findings: design/contract.json:46 and design/contract.json:61 introduce design_host_transport as the Taskplane-to-native-host boundary, but neither the contract set nor design/schemas/r0001-evidence-schemas.json defines a versioned assignment/start/wait/attention/terminal request-result envelope with stable error identities and retryability. design/compatibility.json:47-176 now gives receipt-version windows, mixed host/plugin rollout, and JSON evolution rules, resolving the prior retained-receipt concern, but capability advertisement alone cannot make an independently versioned host adapter's operational outcomes interoperable.
decisions: Keep the current N/last-released receipt compatibility policy, and before Plan add one closed, versioned native-host adapter envelope covering assignment, observed start, wait/attention, terminal collection, and refusal/CAS-conflict outcomes; specify unknown-field behavior, stable error codes, retryable versus permanent and idempotent replay semantics, plus mixed-version compatibility fixtures for the envelope.
